title: Pull - Push - Legs
author: Zach D.
desc:
Slight twist on the classic push pull legs. This program will start with pull instead of push. This is so the back can be fresh for leg day. Recommended schedule for this program:
Day 1: Pull 1
Day 2: Push 1
Day 3: Legs 1
Day 4: Day Off
****At this point if you feel your recovery needs an extra day off you may choose to do so, If you are feeling good only one day off is needed****
Day 5: Pull 2
Day 6: Push 2
Day 7: Legs 2
Day 8: Day Off
****At this point if you feel your recovery needs an extra day off you may choose to do so, If you are feeling good only one day off is needed****

Repeat this cycle until you have concluded the program. 

Progressive Overload on either reps or weight is optimal for this program.

Substitutions can be made, but pick the same muscle group.
